name: OK-VQA
intro: OK-VQA 是需要图像之外知识的开放式视觉问答基准。研究者从 COCO 图像出发，经两轮众包、人工外部知识筛选、答案频率与零一致性过滤，构建 14,055 个问题；每题保留五个答案并标注知识类别。
org: Carnegie Mellon University, Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
build_method: 两轮众包, 人工知识需求筛选, 多标注员类别标注
eval_feature: 外部知识, 开放式答案, 知识类别分解
build_method_en: Two-round Crowdsourcing, Manual Knowledge-need Filtering, Multi-annotator Category Labeling
eval_feature_en: External Knowledge, Open-ended Answers, Knowledge-category Breakdown
intro_en: OK-VQA is an open-ended visual question answering benchmark that requires knowledge beyond the image. Starting from COCO images, the authors use two crowdsourcing rounds, manual external-knowledge screening, answer-frequency filtering, and zero-agreement removal to construct 14,055 questions, retaining five answers and a knowledge-category label for each question.
scale_en: 14,055 questions; 14,031 images; five answers per question

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.00067 Sections 3–4 and the official OK-VQA project. The diagrams preserve random sampling from COCO train/validation images, first-round MTurk question authoring under explicit external-knowledge rules, five independent answers per pair in round two, manual filtering from 86,700 candidates to 34,921 knowledge-dependent questions, removal of counting/detection and nonsensical items, answer-frequency bias control, removal of zero-agreement questions, the 9,009-train/5,046-test split totaling 14,055 questions over 14,031 images, and plurality knowledge-category labels from five workers. Evaluation follows the official open-ended VQA metric, counts each of five answers twice to match the ten-answer convention, applies Porter stemming, and reports both overall and category scores.
